one_line: Do not pursue the permanent restroom reconstruction as prime; the potential four-to-six-month portable restroom requirement fits Temporary 123 but has no confirmed procurement scope yet.
scope: Flagstaff plans to combine two existing Heritage Square restroom rooms into one permanent facility with three toilets, an ADA-accessible partition with an adult changing station, sinks, a custodial closet, and an overhead security door. Staff also anticipates portable restroom units during four to six months of construction, with placement and procurement arrangements still unresolved.
fit: Portable restroom rental, servicing, water support, and waste removal match the company's fleet and core competencies.
Denver portable restroom trailer work and USCG housing and sanitation work provide relevant experience for the temporary facilities portion.
Flagstaff, Arizona falls within the company's stated nationwide service area.
No set-aside is stated, so the supplied notice presents no stated socioeconomic restriction.
Company NAICS 532490 and 561210, PSC W099, and GSA SINs 532490P, 561210FS, and 561210FAC relate to its rental and support services; acceptance for this potential requirement is unconfirmed.
red_flags: This is an agenda/minutes forecast based on YouTube captions, not an issued IFB, sources sought, or RFI.
The main requirement is permanent construction under NAICS 236220, which is absent from the company profile; general contracting qualifications are not documented.
Portable restroom rental may be included in the general contractor's scope or procured separately.
The $250,000 budget covers design, construction, and project management; construction funding remaining is less than $250,000.
No issued drawings, bid schedule, submission instructions, or procurement contact are supplied.
The commission's discussion of site visits concerns commissioner activities, not a mandatory bidder site visit.
competition: No incumbent construction contractor, past construction winners, offer counts, or award benchmarks are supplied. The Downtown Business Alliance clean team cleans the permanent restrooms and will continue; this is not a newly announced cleaning procurement. Staff anticipates award to the lowest responsible bidder within budget.
price_signal: No comparable construction awards or portable restroom allowance are supplied. The $250,000 figure is the entire project budget, not an award estimate for rentals; the $500,000 partition comment is illustrative. Temporary 123's $78,500 USCG award included housing and sanitation and is not directly comparable. The price list leaves currency, billing basis, and delivery terms unspecified, so it cannot establish a four-to-six-month quote.
